rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an uneasy reservation or doubt, including general moral reservations.

example.english: I have some qualm about whether to accept this job.
example.traditional: 對於要唔要接受呢份工作，我有少少顧慮。
example.jyutping: deoi3 jyu1 jiu3 m4 jiu3 zip3 sau6 ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3 ngo5 jau5 siu2 siu2 gu3 leoi6

rows.note: Use this when the qualm is specifically a pang of guilt or troubled conscience rather than a general reservation.

example.english: I have a qualm about eating the cake my colleague left behind.
example.traditional: 我食咗同事留低嘅餅，心裏一直有內疚感。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 tung4 si6 lau4 dai1 ge3 beng2 sam1 leoi5 jat1 zik6 jau5 noi6 gau3 gam2
